svg.text: No siege can take a moon's guns.
The same card, the station in front
More than one moon: the Moons well opens a list,
by name. One of the few places with words.
One heading: the two titles keep their colors and
meet at the hinge. The corner mark on each opens
The wing is the moons' list here. Pressing a moon
One action row for the whole card, for whichever
side is in front. Wells are 44 px. No back well,
Minerva's plate is the activity window. Filled
icons keep you busy; outlined ones only wait.
Rings show how far along. Point at one for its
line. The session sits at the end, in lavender.
Where you are, one piece: the center, the name
How you're looking, one piece: minimap and zoom,
What's built is flat, not ringed: it's a status,
not a button. The ring on Yards is its progress.
The wing keeps the code and the one line that
matters. Prices live in Trade and Details.
Trade is dimmed and says why: one is in flight.
Icons for filters, no title, "celestial bodies".
A Go button on the selected row.
